newsitem.title: UK: N.Ireland Elect mulls court move over OFREG.
newsitem.headline: N.Ireland Elect mulls court move over OFREG.

text.p: Regional utility Northern Ireland Electricity said on Wednesday it was "disappointed" with regulator OFREG's pricing decision and was considering applying to the court for a review of that decision.
OFREG said it would make NIE cut its transmission and distribution prices by 29 percent in 1997/98 and a further two percent annually thereafter.
This compares with a recommendation by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission in April that prices be cut by 25 percent. OFREG had initially sought a 31 percent reduction.
"NIE is disappointed that the director general has decided not to implement the MMC conclusions in full," the company said in a statement.
"We are currently reviewing the detail of his proposals before deciding whether to apply to the court for judicial review of his decision."
In April, NIE welcomed the MMC pricing report but said that it would resist any attempts by OFREG to make changes.
